title: Field trial telemetry gaps delayed root-causing
description: A logger fault caused a data gap during field trials, delaying root-cause analysis of a reported issue.
recommendation: Add a redundant logger on all field trial units going forward.

title: Early DFMEA engagement reduced late design changes
description: Involving DFMEA review from the concept stage caught two high-RPN failure modes before tooling commitment, avoiding a costly late change.
recommendation: Mandate a DFMEA checkpoint at Pre-KO for all future programs of this class.

title: Supplier PPAP tracking dashboard improved on-time submission
description: A shared PPAP tracker with the supplier improved submission timeliness and reduced follow-up effort.
recommendation: Roll out the PPAP tracker as a standard tool for all tier-1 suppliers.

title: Single-source risk materialized during ramp-up
description: A single-source casting supplier could not meet a volume ramp, causing a short supply gap.
recommendation: Qualify a second source for any single-point critical casting before SOP on future programs.

title: Cross-functional weekly review improved risk visibility
description: A consolidated weekly review across Engineering, Quality and Manufacturing surfaced risks earlier than the previous cadence.
recommendation: Adopt the consolidated weekly review format as the program management standard.

title: Tooling trial buffer prevented SOP slip
description: Building a two-week buffer after the first tooling trial absorbed a dimensional correction without impacting the SOP date.
recommendation: Standardize a tooling trial buffer in the master schedule template.
